skill.name: lead-magnets
skill.description: Plan lead magnets for email capture, lead generation, gated content, and content upgrades. The skill helps choose formats, plan gating, outline promotion, and define success metrics.
skill.summary: Plan lead magnets that capture qualified emails and support product adoption.
skill.author: coreyhaines31

security_audit.summary: All five static findings are false positives after context review. The flagged shell pattern is Markdown inline code for local context file names, and the reconnaissance hits are marketing references to paid traffic and promotion.

static_findings.snippet: | First leads | Immediately with existing traffic or paid |
- **ads**: For paid promotion of lead magnets

finding_verdicts.reason: Line 123 is a benchmark row about first leads arriving from existing traffic or paid promotion. It does not instruct system reconnaissance or environment inspection.
The backticks mark local Markdown file names such as .agents/product-marketing.md. The instruction is to read optional context files, not execute Ruby or shell commands.
Line 208 is a section heading for paid promotion in a lead magnet distribution plan. It contains no host, network, or system reconnaissance behavior.
Line 281 asks whether paid amplification applies to a marketing plan. This is normal campaign planning language, not system discovery.
Line 309 references a related ads skill for paid promotion of lead magnets. It is a cross-reference to marketing guidance and not a security-sensitive action.

content.value_statement: Many teams struggle to choose lead magnets that attract qualified prospects instead of casual downloads. This skill helps Claude, Codex, and Claude Code plan offers, gating, distribution, and measurement.
actual_capabilities: Recommends lead magnet formats based on buyer stage, audience, and business goals.
Plans gating strategy, form fields, landing page structure, and delivery methods.
Outlines promotion channels including blog CTAs, social posts, paid ads, and partners.
Defines measurement plans with conversion, lead quality, engagement, and pipeline metrics.
Uses benchmark and format guidance for checklists, templates, ebooks, quizzes, and webinars.
limitations: Does not write the full lead magnet content or final copy.
Does not build interactive calculators, graders, quizzes, or landing pages.
Does not replace legal review for consent, privacy, or data collection requirements.
Benchmark numbers are general guidance and must be tested against real audience data.

use_cases.title: Choose a Lead Magnet Format
use_cases.description: Compare checklists, templates, guides, quizzes, and webinars against audience intent and creation effort.

use_cases.title: Improve Email Capture Conversion
use_cases.description: Review gating, form fields, landing page structure, and delivery choices for a weak performing offer.

use_cases.title: Align Offers With Product Adoption
use_cases.description: Create lead magnet ideas that educate prospects and naturally point toward a trial, demo, or purchase.

prompt_templates.title: Pick a First Lead Magnet
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner planning from a basic business description.
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me choose a lead magnet for this business: [describe business]. My ideal customer is [audience]. My main goal is [email growth, lead quality, product education, or another goal].

prompt_templates.title: Turn Existing Content Into an Offer
prompt_templates.scenario: Use current articles, guides, templates, or internal processes.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review these existing content assets and recommend three lead magnet ideas. For each idea, include the format, buyer stage, unique value, gating approach, and promotion channel.

prompt_templates.title: Diagnose a Low Conversion Offer
prompt_templates.scenario: Improve an existing lead magnet or landing page.
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit this lead magnet strategy. Current offer: [offer]. Traffic source: [source]. Conversion rate: [rate]. Form fields: [fields]. Recommend changes to format, landing page, gate, delivery, and tests.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Full Launch Plan
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced planning for creation, distribution, and measurement.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a complete lead magnet launch plan for [audience] and [product]. Include recommendation, content outline, gating plan, landing page structure, distribution plan, measurement plan, risks, and first A/B tests.

output_examples.input: We sell project management software to marketing agencies and need a lead magnet.
output_examples.output: Recommended offer: an agency capacity planning template. It matches a decision-stage problem, gives fast utility, and naturally connects to project planning workflows.
Likely issue: the offer feels too time intensive. Test a shorter checklist, a five-part email course, or a partial preview with a stronger landing page.

output_examples.input: Our form asks for six fields and signups are low.
output_examples.output: Reduce the form to email only or email plus name. Ask for extra qualification later through enrichment, follow-up, or progressive profiling.

best_practices: Start with one clear buyer problem and one buyer stage.
Ask for the minimum form fields needed for the first useful follow-up.
Measure both conversion rate and lead quality after launch.
anti_patterns: Do not create a broad ebook when a short template or checklist would solve the problem faster.
Do not gate core SEO content when a focused content upgrade can preserve reach.
Do not judge success only by download volume without checking product fit.

faq.question: What kinds of lead magnets can this skill plan?
faq.answer: It can plan checklists, cheat sheets, templates, ebooks, swipe files, mini-courses, quizzes, webinars, and resource libraries.

faq.question: Can it write the final ebook or checklist?
faq.answer: It plans the format, outline, gate, promotion, and metrics. Use a writing skill for the full content draft.

faq.question: Can it help with low conversion rates?
faq.answer: Yes. It reviews offer fit, buyer stage, traffic source, landing page structure, form length, delivery, and A/B test ideas.

faq.question: Does it support B2B and B2C offers?
faq.answer: Yes. The guidance adapts by audience, buyer stage, traffic source, offer value, and sales motion.

faq.question: Does it build interactive tools?
faq.answer: No. It can recommend when an interactive tool may be better, but a separate tool-building skill should handle implementation.

faq.question: What inputs improve the output?
faq.answer: Provide the ideal customer, product value, current lead generation data, existing content assets, traffic sources, and business goal.
